site.name: Pradyuman
site.about:
I'm a senior at the University of Texas at Dallas, specializing in character rigging and digital animation. I build rigs that give animators freedom — systems that are technically robust yet intuitive to use.

My work sits at the intersection of engineering and artistry. Whether it's a creature that needs to move believably across terrain or a face that has to carry an entire performance, I approach every project with precision and care.

Currently seeking opportunities in film, games, and visual effects.

projects.title: Restaurant Takeaway Commercial
projects.overview: A commercial advertisement created to promote a client's takeaway and delivery services. As the Video Editor and Creative Lead, I edited across multiple post-production tools while shaping the overall creative direction of the commercial. The project was completed in one week, delivering a energetic, engaging commercial optimized for social media platforms.

projects.title: Cartoon Car Rig
projects.overview: A breakdown of a car rig in a cartoon manner for a short animation. This video features ribbon rigs, squash and stretch, and custom controls. The whole rig was completed within the span of a week.

projects.title: Chaotic Driving Short
projects.overview: This short features a cartoon car achieving great feats to overcome the traffic. Autodesk Maya's MASH toolset was utlisized to simulate the traffic crowd, the color randomization and the motion paths for the respective instances of the main car model. This short was completed from start to finish in the span of two weeks as part of the 2026 Animation Jam hosted by The University of Texas at Dallas' Animation Guild.

projects.title: Industrial Box Render
projects.overview: A hyper-realistic 3D product render created for Altor Solutions for use on their website. As the 3D Generalist, I handled the modeling, texturing, and lighting to create a detailed and realistic representation of the industrial package design. The project was completed over a month.

projects.title: University Motion Graphics Commercial
projects.overview: A short motion graphics commercial created for the Bass School of Arts, Humanities and Technology at UTD, targeting incoming students. As the Modeler and Animator, I contributed 3D modeling, texturing, and animation while assisting with project planning and coordination. The project was completed over three months for publication on the Bass School’s official social media platforms.

projects.title: Character Walk Cycle
projects.overview: Stylized walk cycle with full body mechanics, weight shifts, and follow-through on secondary elements.

projects.title: Acting Shot
projects.overview: A pantomime performance piece focused on silhouette, timing, and emotional readability.

projects.title: Senior Thesis
projects.overview: Capstone project combining original character design, full production rig, and a narrative animation sequence.
